_comment: Advisory Lighthouse budgets (see .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml). performance = minimum score, lcp/tbt in ms (max), cls (max), scriptKb = max transferred JavaScript in KB. Calibrated on the first GitHub-runner run (2026-10-24) and set slightly below it so regressions are flagged; shared runners are noisy, so re-run before acting and re-calibrate after intentional app changes.
